methods.runtime_bench_ms: Median elapsed time of three batches of ten iterations, divided by ten. Each pair ran one signed module at a time. first_fit scans all blocks and rc scans only free blocks.
methods.controls: Same signed timing probes as the historical run. Median of seven batches after two warmups, divided by 32 for the neural network or 256 for other controls.
methods.coremark: Three fresh installs per fitting module. An allocation failure on the first install ends the series.
methods.mqtt: 48 command-to-acknowledgement round trips with QoS 1 over TLS per board.
methods.console_free_heap_bytes: Single console readings. Includes available PSRAM on ESP-IDF.
